# `WorldApi::get_hovered_cell`

## Description

Returns the currently hovered world cell when the caller supplied input context.

## Signature

```rust
fn get_hovered_cell (& self) -> Option < UVec2 >
```

## Arguments

This method does not take plugin-supplied arguments.

## Return Value

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/worldapi-get-hovered-cell.md`](../../examples/methods/worldapi-get-hovered-cell.md)_

```rust
if let Some(cell) = world.get_hovered_cell() {
    let info = world.get_cell_info(cell)?;
```
